comment: Explicit product-private classifications for discovered /_cokret/* paths that are not registered protocol operations. The operation registry gate fails any unregistered discovered path unless it is listed here with classification=product-private and a reason.

allowed.reason: Test-only conformance harness namespace; mounted only when ck.profile.conformance_harness.v1 is active and not advertised as a protocol operation.
Local tus companion transport for ck.self.blob.upload.create; kept out of the operation registry until resumable-upload bindings are modeled as first-class operations.
Local tus companion transport for ck.self.blob.upload.create; upload resources and finalize are node-local staging affordances, not independent protocol operations.
SDK discovery/client support for soland's tus companion upload binding, not a registered Arkret operation.
SDK discovery/client support for soland's tus companion upload binding, not a registered Arkret operation.
Client-side support for soland's tus companion upload binding, not a registered Arkret operation.

Negative-surface probe: schema_policy_realtime/schema.rs asserts these schema-registry endpoints respond 404 unrecognized_endpoint, i.e. it confirms the absence of a schema-registry operation rather than calling one.

Negative-surface probe: schema_policy_realtime/schema.rs asserts GET/DELETE on a schema resource respond 404 unrecognized_endpoint; confirms the schema-registry operation does not exist, so there is no operation to register.
Synthetic unknown path used by service-surface-contract.spec.ts to assert soland's canonical 404 unrecognized_endpoint envelope; deliberately not a protocol operation.
Synthetic unknown path used by api_contracts_auth.rs to assert the canonical 404 unrecognized_endpoint envelope; deliberately not a protocol operation.

Mock audit-agent harness surface (identity, inbox, accessed, invite) served by the cotest mock-audit-agent process via mockAuditAgentBaseUrl()/setup.agentBaseUrl, not soland; no corresponding protocol operation exists.

Negative method probe: key-backup-restore.spec.ts legacyGetBackup issues GET on a backup resource that the registry/soland expose only via PUT/DELETE, asserting 404/405; the GET method binding is intentionally absent, not a protocol operation.

registry-drift.spec.ts scans this as a may-4xx surface; soland does not route /_cokret/self/notifications and the registry defines no notifications operation, so it is a tolerated probe rather than a protocol operation.

Negative method probe: service-surface-contract.spec.ts, api_contracts_auth.rs and service_surface.rs POST the GET-only /_cokret/describe endpoint to assert a 405 method_not_allowed; the POST binding is intentionally absent, not a protocol operation.

Negative-surface probe: extension_surface_gaps.rs asserts this realm-scoped agent path responds 404 unrecognized_endpoint (agents are provisioned via /_cokret/self/agents, not a realm sub-resource); confirms absence, not a protocol operation.

Negative-surface probe: extension_surface_gaps.rs asserts this realm-scoped applet path responds 404 unrecognized_endpoint (applets install via /_cokret/self/applets/install); confirms absence, not a protocol operation.

policy-server-check.spec.ts builds a mockPolicyServerBaseUrl()/_cokret/self/policy/check URL string for its mock policy server; the canonical soland operation is POST /_cokret/self/policy/check, so this PUT-flavoured mock URL is not a protocol operation.

Router prefix container in applet_server.rs (Router::with_path("_cokret/edge/applet")) that mounts the real ping/describe/transactions/actors/realms/protocols operations; the bare prefix is not itself an operation.
Placeholder method/path in an http-client unit test that only exercises request-option header application (Method::PUT chosen arbitrarily); /_cokret/self/events is registered under GET/POST, not PUT.
Router prefix container in starid server lib.rs (Router::with_path("_cokret/root")) that mounts the real root/identity/* operations; the bare prefix is not itself an operation.
Router prefix container in teabay routing.rs (Router::with_path("_cokret/find/directory")) that mounts the real announce/withdraw/takedown/push operations; the bare prefix is not itself an operation.

mockCokretApi.ts uses the literal "/_cokret/self/realms/" only as a startsWith() prefix to dispatch to the real /_cokret/self/realms/{realm_id}/spaces and /strands handlers; the bare prefix string is a router predicate, not an operation.

Malformed path template recovered from the mockCokretApi.ts regex /^\/_cokret\/self\/circles\/([^/]+)\/(archive|restore|tombstone)$/ (the capture-group '(' leaks into the extracted template); the mock actually dispatches the registered circle archive/restore/tombstone operations.
